extension.summary: Sync your Silo movies and TV shows into the Kodi library
extension.description: SiloKodiConnect writes the movies and TV shows on your Silo server into Kodi's own video library, so every skin, widget and library feature treats them like local media. Watched state and resume points stay in step both ways, and playback streams from Silo: the original file when Kodi can play it, a converted stream otherwise. Community project: not made or endorsed by the Silo team.
extension.disclaimer: Do not run Kodi's "Clean library" on Silo items; SiloKodiConnect manages them itself.
extension.news:
0.11.0: Silo's box sets as Kodi movie sets (one card per box set in a Silo-style skin's grid, a box set page, a film's box set), your 1-5 star ratings, Rotten Tomatoes' critics' score, a Coming Soon row, show theme tunes from Silo, Dolby Atmos on live UHD channels, the quick guide's channel groups, and the playing episode's season and next episode for a player's Episodes and Next Episode buttons. No pop-up after Watchlist or Mark watched; plugin rows no longer reload when playback starts or stops.
0.10.0: Silo Requests (Discover and Yours), faster Home rows published as cards, Remove from Continue Watching, Top 10 rows chosen in the settings, chart places, new-episode and time-left marks, trailers, watchlist, person pages and collections for a skin, Live TV quick guide, catch-up and recent channels, sign-in from the Silo phone app. Fixes: unwatched marks reach Silo, late intros count as credits, SVG logos skipped, watched shows marked in lazy rows, the relay's commands need a token.
0.9.3: profile avatar, ambient tints, More Like This, season paths, library collections and an info route for the Silo Skyline skin; Continue Watching from the add-on menu works again.
0.9.2: pages, rows and title details for the Silo Skyline skin; cast on widget items; library updates only when titles come or go.
0.9.1: sync once per Silo library scan instead of once per scan step (Silo also sent each change twice).
0.9.0: first release. Movies and TV synced into the Kodi library, sign-in with a TV code, streaming playback with Dolby Vision (including profile 7) and TrueHD passthrough, watched state and resume points both ways, Silo home rows as widgets, and skip intro plus credits timing through Up Next.
